summary: Implemented the Admin commission policies, account overrides, exception, history, and confirmation surfaces for ADM-39 through ADM-45. The implementation uses the current API contracts and localized Arabic, English, and Simplified Chinese projections, enforces Admin Desktop-only scope and view-only mutation restrictions, preserves sensitive reason requirements, and exposes only redacted commission history and provider-safe account data.

scopeNotes: Admin Dashboard scope is approved Desktop-only; Arabic is RTL and English/Simplified Chinese are LTR. Tablet/mobile browser projects were intentionally skipped for this task.
The UI does not hardcode a universal commission or advertising price, does not imply automatic bank verification, and does not expose raw audit snapshots, private data, or provider-internal metadata.
View-only Admin sessions keep policy, account-override, and exception mutations disabled; API authentication and RBAC remain authoritative.
Backend commission route truth repairs were completed as separate authorized prerequisites and are not included as frontend_071 runtime changes.
